input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept restrictions on the products or businesses we may build, buy, or sell, so we have deleted the 24-month, all-territory non-compete in 12.4, which also directly contradicts the freedom-of-action acknowledgement in 12.3. If you need protection for a specific offering, we could consider a term-only restriction on a single named competing product, capped at 12 months, with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
input.summary: Delete the non-compete imposed on Customer in § 12.4.
